notes:
Lead: Saltmarsh Insight Grid — mid-market product analytics platform focused on product discovery + in-app help. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API first (quick onboarding) then Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latencies across their EU+NA clusters.

Meeting notes / call snippets:
- 2026-01-15 demo w/ AE Claire + SE Diego. Showed embeddings pipeline and semantic search flows. Product lead (Aisha, Head of Product) said: "Search relevance must match our current BM25+rerank baseline — can't regress."
- 2026-01-22 POC kickoff: ingest 150k documents (docs, support tickets, release notes) into Pinecone + Redwood-hosted embeddings. POC objective: quality parity + cost/latency analysis.
- 2026-02-12 Hosted POC wrap: created 132k embeddings, ran 48h load test. Key findings: average embedding latency (hosted) 18ms per vector, end-to-end p95 query (embedding + kNN + rerank) ~180ms w/ Pinecone in us-east, spikes to 280ms for eu-west routed queries. Batch embed job completed ~110k docs in 4.5h using 10 parallel workers (S3->batch endpoint).
- 2026-02-20 security review: supplied SOC2 report and draft data residency flow. Legal requires explicit retention policy for EU customers; current Hosted defaults are ok for dev but Production requires VPC/Dedicated and EU regional tenancy.
- Pricing call 2026-02-28: finance asked for committed-tier pricing for Dedicated (3x baseline throughput). They want unit economics model mapping to batch vs real-time costs.

POC acceptance criteria (as defined by Saltmarsh):
- Quality: semantic-search recall+precision at or above current BM25+reranker on 10 eval queries.
- Latency: p95 end-to-end < 200ms for NA, < 250ms EU with Dedicated target < 150ms p95 globally.
- Throughput: sustained 250 QPS for semantic queries, burst to 600 QPS. Nightly batch embed: 500k docs/day target for future scale.
- Integration: connector to Pinecone & ability to switch to Milvus (self-host) with minimal changes; S3-native batch ingestion for ETL.

Tech preferences / constraints:
- Prefer smaller quantized open models for embeddings (2-8B) to keep cost predictable. Considering Redwood recommendations for quantized variants.
- Need routing/fallback: cheaper embedding model for background batch jobs; higher-quality model for realtime queries.
- Vector DB: currently using Pinecone; engineering wants an apples-to-apples perf comparison with Milvus on Dedicated.

Commercial / organizational notes:
- Economic sensitivity: mid-market procurement — wants committed discount for Dedicated (annual). Target ARR range discussed $120k-$250k depending on reserved throughput and data residency add-ons.
- Champions: Aisha (Head of Product) + Marcus (CTO). Marcus cares about SLA, predictable latency, and KMS integration for keys.
- Quote from Marcus: "If latency and costs scale predictably, we can consolidate multiple third-party vendors."

Next steps / short list:
- Redwood: prepare detailed Dedicated pricing tiers for 3 commit levels + EU region add-on (deliver by 2026-03-05).
- SE: run cross-connector perf test (Pinecone vs Milvus) on Dedicated staging cluster (2-week benchmark).
- Legal: confirm data residency + retention templates; draft addendum for EU customers.
- Product: schedule 60m follow-up to review perf numbers and rollout plan (target week of 2026-03-10).
